compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Fourteen `tests/interfaces/facades` files contain audited prose that repeats behavior, preserves incident history, or narrates obvious setup. Scope was revalidated on `origin/main@0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`.

## Approach
Condense only comments and true leading docstrings in the named blocks. Preserve non-docstring runtime strings, assertions, executable behavior, and exact shebang/tool directives.

For every changed Python file, parse pinned-before and final text with `type_comments=True`; remove only leading docstrings from modules, classes, functions, and async functions; normalize `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; and require the remaining ASTs to match. Compare shebang and directive-bearing physical lines separately and byte-for-byte.

## Scope
- `test_attestation_parity_heldout_2e16.py` module prose — retain persisted-attestation parity and deliberate no-sign behavior.
- `test_bridge_programmatic.py` Jira soft-degradation section, missing-project parameter note, and the docstrings on `test_incomplete_jira_scope_yields_a_typed_verdict_not_a_crash` and `test_absent_credentials_surface_as_a_typed_error_naming_the_variables` — retain typed fail-closed errors, required inputs, and no-network setup.
- `test_central_mount_gate_ad9f.py` module and scoped test prose — retain store-touching auto-mount and help/no-store non-mutation.
- `test_cli_argparse.py` module prose — retain routing, stream, and exit contracts.
- `test_cli_js_safe_integers.py` module and `ns_ticket` docstrings — retain JS-safe wire encoding and deterministic inexact timestamps; do not edit `_HLC_INEXACT_BASE_NS` or its assignment.
- `test_fsck_structured_326f.py` module and scoped test prose — retain completed structured results, true failures, and separate recovery output.
- `test_mcp.py::test_readonly_empty_env_is_a_fault_not_a_disable` docstring — retain the empty-value fail-closed contract and stronger error oracle.
- `test_mcp_http_transport.py` scoped shutdown prose — retain instrument-before-offload, stop-intake, drain-before-exit, and the short uvicorn backstop.
- `test_mcp_js_safe_integers.py` module and scoped test prose — retain JS-safe encoding, schema allowance, and agreement between structured/content response halves.
- `test_mcp_list_read_surface.py` module and scoped test prose — retain lean-field exclusions, wire-size accounting, hard refusal, and valid remedies.
- `test_mcp_push_status.py` module prose — retain caller-visible delivery state because server stderr is unavailable.
- `test_mcp_stateless_transport.py` scoped transport prose — retain stateless blue-green routing and why retirement cannot rescue old session IDs.
- `test_plan_review_attestation_facades.py` module and scoped test prose — retain retryability parity and sidecar-loss recovery.
- `test_verify_completion_facades.py` module prose — retain CLI/MCP scope, offline seam, exit/schema contract, and default gating.

Preserve every existing `noqa`, `type: ignore`, `pragma`, shebang, and test assertion exactly.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The leaf commit changes only comments, true leading docstrings, or adjacent blank lines in Scope; normalized AST equality and exact directive-line comparison both pass.
- [ ] Each edited block is shorter and keeps its current non-obvious contract or rationale without moving repetition, history, or ornament elsewhere.
- [ ] A reviewer who did not author the edits posts a leaf-linked TSV with one row per edited block: path/block, immutable before citation, final-commit after citation (or DELETED plus neighbor), preserved contract/consumer, before/after words, semantic-preservation verdict, bloat-removal verdict, and reviewer session.
- [ ] Every TSV row records `semantic-preservation=PASS` and `bloat-removal=PASS`; missing or failing rows block closure.
- [ ] Focused tests, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify` pass.

## Verification
Run the recorded normalized AST/directive guard, `pytest tests/interfaces/facades`, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and `make verify`. The independent TSV is authoritative for prose quality.

rtk proxy env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python -c 'import re, subprocess, sys
BASE="0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e"
PATTERN=re.compile(r"^#!|#\s*(?:noqa\b|type:\s*ignore\b|pragma:\s*no cover\b|fmt:|ruff:|pyright:|mypy:)")
def lines(ref, path):
    raw=subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{ref}:{path}"], text=True)
    return [line for line in raw.splitlines() if PATTERN.search(line)]

    before=lines(BASE, path)
    after=lines("HEAD", path)
    if before != after:
